paper.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift

paper_context.research_question: Does the declared mini-batch transform produce zero means and unit variances?
paper_context.method: Apply the paper's normalization transform to a deterministic 4-by-2 batch.
paper_context.data_and_splits: Synthetic batch under this repository's MIT license.
paper_context.training_or_inference: No network training; one direct algorithm evaluation.
paper_context.evaluation_protocol: Extract the maximum mean/variance invariant error.
paper_context.limitations: Algorithmic invariant, not the ImageNet error or training-step speedup.
